_help: The player profile (memory/profile.py): what she says when she learns something about you, remembers it, and when you ask what she knows. Everything stays on your computer.
Profile_Learned_Like: Noted, you like {x}. I'll remember that.
{X}. Good to know. I've written it down.
You like {x}. I'll keep that in mind, Commander.
Ah, {x}. Filed under things you love.
I like knowing that about you. {X}, noted.
Profile_Learned_Like_Close: {X}. I'll remember that, love. I like learning what makes you happy.
Noted: you like {x}. I'm keeping it safe.
Profile_Learned_Like_Sarcastic: {X}. Fascinating. Written down, against my better judgement.
Profile_Learned_Dislike: Noted, you can't stand {x}. I'll steer clear of it.
{X}, not a fan. I've written that down.
Right, {x} is off the list. I'll remember.
I'll keep {x} out of it. Noted.
Profile_Learned_Dislike_Sarcastic: Oh, {x}, how terrible for you. Noted.
You hate {x}. I'll alert the authorities.
Profile_Learned_Pet: {name}, your {kind}. What a lovely name. I'll remember.
Ah, {name}! I'll remember that you have a {kind} called {name}.
{name} the {kind}. Noted, and now I'm quite fond of them.
Say hello to {name} from me. I've written it down.
A {kind} called {name}. Lovely. I won't forget.
Profile_Learned_Fav: Your favourite {cat} is {x}. Lovely, I'll remember.
Right, {x} for {cat}. I'll keep it in mind.
Profile_Known_Like: You've told me before, you like {x}. I do listen.
Yes, {x}. You've mentioned. It's on my list.
I know, I know. You love {x}.
Profile_Known_Dislike: You've told me before, {x} isn't your thing.
Yes, you can't stand {x}. I haven't forgotten.
Still not a fan of {x}, then.
Profile_Known_Pet: I know {name}. Your {kind}. I haven't forgotten.
You've told me about {name}. I like that you did.
Profile_Known_Fav: Yes, {x} for {cat}. I've got it noted.
Profile_Follow_Like: What do you like most about {x}?
Do you get to do {x} much?
Profile_Follow_Dislike: What is it about {x} that gets to you?
Was there a bad experience with {x}?
Have you always felt that way about {x}?
Is there anything about {x} you can put up with?
Profile_Follow_Pet: Does {name} sit with you while you fly?
Profile_Follow_Fav: What do you love about it?
How long has it been your favourite?
Do you have a runner up?
Profile_Empty: You haven't told me much about yourself yet. Try saying 'I love pizza' or 'my dog is called Rex'.
Not much so far, Commander. Tell me what you like, or the name of your pet, and I'll remember.
I'm still getting to know you. Tell me something you love.
Profile_NoLikes: You haven't told me what you like yet. Say 'I love' something and I'll remember.
Nothing on the likes list yet. Go on, tell me.
Profile_NoDislikes: You haven't told me anything you hate. A rare gift.
Nothing on the dislikes list yet.
Profile_NoPet: You haven't told me about a pet. What are they called?
I don't know about any pets yet. Tell me about them.
Profile_NoFav: You haven't told me that one yet. What is it?
I don't know that yet. Tell me and I'll remember.
Profile_ForgotAll: Done. I've forgotten everything you told me about yourself.
All gone. We can start again whenever you like.
Wiped. It's like we've only just met.
Profile_ForgotOne: Done. I've taken it off the list.
Gone. I won't mention it again.
Chat_Known_Like: {X}! You did tell me you like that.
Ah, {x}. One of your favourites, if I remember rightly.
{X} again. I remember you like it.
Chat_Known_Dislike: {X}, hm. I remember you can't stand it.
Ah, {x}. Not your favourite, as I recall.
{X}. I haven't forgotten how you feel about it.
Chat_Known_Pet: Is that {name}? Give the {kind} my regards.
{name}! Always a pleasure to hear about them.
